research_question: Do additional page-bound later Mei/Siku received-text loci around 微 and 去子 demonstrate source-formula-dependent place labeling rather than supplying an early G893 少/微 conversion or a universal exponent?

source.scan_family: Later Siku-derived Mei received/facsimile corpus, NOT authenticated early Xu-An1599/1600 or G893 physical plate

exact_source_page_bound_transcription_fr: 二率　五百七十四分〈為十分八百二十而用其七〉
〈乃度下二位分故加定二子也立大元一〉
〈子单㣲之下者如一子於實之微下一位〉
〈也所以然者前所推數皆止于秒秒以下〉
received_page_evidence.scope: Different source-specific solar/lunar eclipse calculation with explicit positional-unit and discarded-below-second wording. The received text contains damaged/uncertain glyphs and is not a verified high-resolution original collation.
received_page_evidence.thumbnail_observation: Wikimedia 1280-px p934 thumbnail rendered in web showing a rotated source page with an arithmetic diagram and vertical prose, but exact small-note glyphs were not independently certified from locally saved source-native pixels.

exact_source_page_bound_transcription_fr: 得數又以所推定限行度〈去四子空度去三子〉為法除之〈不滿法去一子〉
〈所定有六子為百分五子為十分〉得為所推既内分也
received_page_evidence.scope: A distinct eclipse internal-phase calculation explicitly couples the 去子 instruction to a denominator, unit slots, and resulting fraction. It cannot be collapsed with the 0795 p922 九十六分 example or 0794 p561 820-rate locus without edition, units and full-number replay.
received_page_evidence.thumbnail_observation: Direct p948 1280-px thumbnail retrieval timed out; received web text was visible.

comparison_with_prior: 13XW and 13XX previously acquired a different source-native Mei v21 p91 and distinguished large-line 去二 from small interlinear 子; those native bytes remain the higher-grade authority for THAT locus.
13XY and 13XZ already bound 0795 p922 received 九十六分, 去三子, 退二位 and a thumbnail-only route, without source-native image bytes.
13YA adds two different, formula-scoped received pages about 位/微/去子; does not retroactively adjudicate the p922 small annotation, the p91 source-native operator or any early original G893 unit.

interpretation.positive: Place-keeping terminology in these later received passages is formula- and column-context-dependent; the textual '子' is not independently an integer subtraction, and '微下一位' in a later example cannot by itself establish the G893 original 少/微 radix or carry.
interpretation.not_proven: Neither a universal power-of-ten shift nor a fixed 820−2/818 divisor, nor the identity of a '微' precision lane across Mei, Xing j45, Ming official tables and G893 has been established.

next_action: Prioritize a lawfully accessible authenticated independent Xu-An1599/1600 j45 B-L132 original leaf and native early 疾/少微 instructions, with original bytes and SHA/page/print copy binding; use later Mei page934/p948 only as scoped received controls if the underlying DjVu/source images become obtainable.
transmission_impact: NONE; same later Siku-derived Mei text family, no newly authenticated physical witness, original G893 numeric field or lineage edge.
